## Research interests

- AI for science: how AI can be genuinely useful to scientists (e.g. helping them find the lesser-known prior work that sparks new ideas, as in MUSES), and what widespread AI use means for how science is done, validated, and communicated.
- AI for healthcare: using AI to tackle public-health challenges (homelessness, opioid overdose) and making AI work in real-world healthcare settings, from messy electronic health records (EHRs) to clinical workflows.
- Science of AI: understanding what makes AI systems, especially large language models (LLMs), work or fail, and how to make them better.
